Name: Mossy Witchy Outfits and Horns by b0rszcz for Fashion Sense
Author: b0rszcz
Description:
Trying out if i'm cut out for making bigger mods. Turns out that I'm, in fact, not. I got bored after second dress. How do y'all stay motivated is truly impressive to me.


[b]What this mod adds:
[/b] - 3 new dresses, that look like you were rolling in a swamp in them (𝓪𝓮𝓼𝓽𝓱𝓮𝓽𝓲𝓬𝓪𝓵𝓵𝔂, ofc)
 - 2 pairs of new horns, with flowery and non-flowery variants
 - 2 new crowns, with mossy and non-mossy variants

[b]Compatibility:[/b]
- 1.6 update
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15730]FS - Rainmoon's Elf Ear[/url] 
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7732]Expressive Elf Ears FS and Overlay[/url]﻿﻿

[b]Requirements[/b]: 
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense
[/url]
[b]How to Install:
[/b]- Unzip the file
- Move the folder into your StardewValley/mods folder
- Use a hand mirror (purchasable at Pierre's)
- Done!
